items.body:
Taylor Swift has announced an original song, ‘I Knew It, I Knew You’, that's set to be featured in the original soundtrack for the upcoming film Toy Story 5. The track was written with longtime collaborator Jack Antonoff and is set to arrive on 5 June, ahead of the film’s worldwide release on 19 June.

‘I Knew It, I Knew You’ marks Taylor’s return to her country roots and was inspired by everyone's favourite cowgirl, Jessie. According to Taylor, she wrote the track after getting an early look at the upcoming film, sharing that the story immediately resonated with her.

Toy Story 5 director Andrew Stanton also praised the song, highlighting Taylor’s connection to Jessie and the way she understood the character’s emotional journey. He described the track as one that feels deeply connected to the world of Toy Story, as though it had always belonged there.

Taylor first teased the announcement with mysterious and playful billboards that were spotted in Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, San Francisco, Toronto, Mexico City, and London. Each board featured the letters "TS" in the iconic Toy Story font, alongside a Toy Story-themed countdown on her website, following days of fan speculation surrounding her involvement in the film.

After the countdown ended, she finally revealed the surprise on her social media platforms with the caption:

It’s a Toy Story. You knew it! My new original song 'I Knew It, I Knew You' for Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5 will be yours on June 5th. I’ve always dreamed of getting to write for these characters who I’ve adored since I was a 5-year-old kid watching the first Toy Story movie. I fell instantly in love with Toy Story 5 when I was lucky enough to see it in its early stages, and I wrote this song as soon as I got home from the screening. Sometimes you just know, right?

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Taylor Swift (@taylorswift)

Toy Story 5 will bring back Woody, Buzz, and Jessie, as the film sees the toys facing a new challenge in the form of children’s growing attachment to electronics. The film will also feature Randy Newman’s returning score.

With both the song and film arriving this June, fans of Taylor Swift and the beloved Toy Story 5 franchise have plenty to look forward to. Blending Swift's heartfelt songwriting with the emotional storytelling that has defined the Toy Story series for decades, ‘I Knew It, I Knew You’ is shaping up to be a memorable addition to the film's soundtrack and a fitting companion to Jessie’s next chapter.

items.body:
FIFTY FIFTY embrace flaws and encourage self-discovery on their bold and reflective EP, Imperfect-I’mperfect. The six-track record sees the quartet explore their unique identities and use their artistry to transcend insecurity and instil confidence in themselves and fans.

Life is an unpredictable path that hurls all kinds of situations at us at any time. The EP reinforces the message that perfection is not the ultimate goal. Each song adds a piece to the message that it's impossible to be happy and positive all the time, moments of sorrow and pain aren't weakness, but showcase strength in the ability to be vulnerable. The group first gave fans a glimpse into the record with the pre-release single 'STARSTRUCK'. It was a sonic pivot for the group as they began to build a genre-blurring soundscape with the track's futuristic and electronic music elements. Fusing glowing synth melodies with distorted vocals, the track exudes a retro-cyberpunk style.

At the core of the album lies the focus track 'Like A Bubble'. Much like the title, it talks about shedding the weight of societal expectations and floating through life. The song lies on a fluttery melody and buoyant rhythm that oozes with playful charm and confidence as it encourages listeners to love themselves just as they are, without worrying about conforming. The music video that accompanies the track captures the sense of childlike wonder that comes with being carefree, infusing animated elements that make it feel like an otherworldly dreamscape.

The album takes a wistful turn with the delicate melodies of 'Took It Too Far', which follows the push and pull of a toxic relationship that you can't quite walk away from. 'Genie Magic' picks up the groove once again with its explosive energy and bright chiming synths, celebrating the blissful surprises that romance can bring.

Zeroing in on authenticity and raw honesty, 'PERFECT' blends dreamy R&B textures with subtle retro influences, capturing the thrill of first love through a heartfelt yet confident confession. The record comes to a close with the full and layered musical arrangements on 'Carry On', which instils a sense of hope for the journey ahead with its bright soaring melodies.

Through its mix of dynamic pop tracks and reflective moments, Imperfect-I’mperfect reinforces FIFTY FIFTY’s status as one of pop’s most promising rising acts. Balancing vulnerability with self-assurance, the EP transforms moments of doubt, heartbreak, and uncertainty into a powerful message of self-acceptance, showcasing the group's growing artistic confidence and emotional depth.

items.body:
Get ready to feel the heat, passion, and rush of a charged summer romance as LIL LEAGUE from EXILE TRIBE teams up with NEX and AA from rising Thai pop group BUS because of you i shine. 'LOCA' is also set to claim its spot on LIL LEAGUE from EXILE TRIBE's upcoming double A-side single release.

Translating to crazy in English, 'LOCA' is centred around an alluring woman with fiery and irresistible qualities, whisking listeners into the vibrant hues of a tropical sunset. The track marks a milestone moment for the group as it's their first collaborative track. The bilingual track predominantly features English lyrics, with NEX and AA delivering seamless Japanese vocals, marking an exchange of culture and musical styles.

The addictive rhythm of the track melts into the synth-driven melodies, creating a seductive ensemble that radiates not just the heat of romance but the warm embrace of a summery island escapade. The music video perfectly sets the scene of the track as it was filmed on the beautiful sandy beaches of Pattaya, Thailand.

A mysterious woman dressed in red draws the attention of LIL LEAGUE from EXILE TRIBE members as she walks along the shore, as they try to woo her by describing her effortless glow. As the video unfolds, the focus also shifts to include their new friendships as they enjoy their time on the island. They meet NEX and AA, who work at a seaside café, and have fun together under the Thai sun.

Beyond just a collaboration, 'LOCA' highlights the evolving sound and cross-cultural future of Asian pop. Bringing together Japanese and Thai musical influences, multilingual vocals, and the chemistry between the artists, the track serves as a vibrant celebration of cultural exchange while showcasing the limitless possibilities of music that transcends borders.

items.body:
SHINee transcends the confines of genre and reality with the otherworldly allure of their sixth mini album, Atmos. The six-track album is a testament to the group's growth and the evolution of their sonic individuality.

Each track on the record is a blend of a spectrum of genres, reinforcing the group's versatility. As they incorporate styles like electronic pop, funk, R&B, and dance music, fusing them with their evocative lyricism and lush production, they unveil a new alter ego in their artistry, one that preserves their signature sound while encouraging experimentation through each song on the tracklist.

At the heart of the album lies the title track 'Atmos', which presents a heavy synth-driven melody fuelled by addictive house-style rhythms to truly create a dreamlike soundscape. The song is a quiet documentation of the euphoria that comes with spending time with that special person. Weaving the meaningful verses with the diverse musicality, the track is a quiet depiction of the ultimate form of love, strong enough to grant peace.

The music video aligns with an otherworldly concept, toggling between two realities. With one set in the dark and gloomy background of the thick darkness of late nights in the city, walking through foggy tunnels to find a refreshing countryside where the sun never seems to set. It follows the idea of the butterfly effect as each member crosses paths, stumbling across something each of the other characters loses along the way, like a pair of tangled earbuds or a pair of silver-framed glasses.

SHINee traverses the myriad genres with each track, beginning with 'HOURS', which drips with addictive disco and funk energy perfect to get your groove on, flowing seamlessly into the raw and gritty grunge, alternative rock beat of 'Possibility'. Pivoting towards a more delicate, melodious sound, the music floats into the ethereal electronic-pop sound of 'Anti Believer' and the relaxed R&B-pop groove of 'Still Raining'. The mini album closes on a high note with the glowing radiance of positivity on 'Thousand Miles Away', urging fans to forge their own path to a brighter future.

With Atmos, SHINee once again prove why they remain one of K-pop's most innovative and enduring acts. Blending genre-defying musicality with immersive storytelling and dreamlike visuals, the mini album captures the group's willingness to evolve while staying true to the artistry and emotional depth that have defined their legacy for years.

items.body:
Following a monumental 20 year career, T.O.P gives back to fans who have supported him throughout his journey with a free fan meeting event. Taking place on 9 July at the Pia Arena MM in Yokohama, the venue capacity makes it possible for 10,000 to join and catch their favourite idol live on stage.

Earlier this year, T.O.P announced that he could not be joining G-DRAGON, Taeyang, and Daesung for the highly anticipated festivities as part of BIGBANG's 20th anniversary. While he continues to forge his own path, he thanks fans for their support, despite his decision to continue on as a solo artist. "The fan meet and greet is a performance that T.O.P planned as a gift to the fans who have shown him steady love and support," Topspot Pictures comments.

As he marks two decades in the industry, the fan meeting serves as both a celebration of T.O.P’s remarkable journey and a heartfelt thank-you to the fans who have stood by him through every chapter of his career. With 10,000 fans set to gather in the arena, the special event promises to be an emotional and memorable occasion, bringing artist and fans together to celebrate 20 years of music, growth, and shared memories.

Spotlighting outstanding music and achievements from some of the industry's biggest names is what the MUSIC AWARDS JAPAN 2026 is all about. But no celebration is complete without the electrifying energy of live music, and this year's lineup of performers is set to keep the crowd on their feet. With an exciting roster of artists taking the stage, the second edition of the awards promises to be an unforgettable and iconic spectacle.

With a mix of J-pop heavyweights, K-pop legends and western trailblazers creating an all star lineup of performers, the ceremony is shaping up to be packed with explosive energy and live renditions of hit tracks.

Kicking off the bill are some of J-pop’s fiery frontrunners, with the reverberating rhythms of Kenshi Yonezu alongside the groovy, genre-blending sounds of Fujii Kaze and the power-packed energy of rising girl group HANA. Representing K-pop on the regional stage is MISAMO, the sub unit from legendary girl group TWICE comprising members Momo, Sana, and Mina.

Pledging to champion music regardless of language or borders, Sam Smith is set to bring his award winning melodies and bold expressive performance to the stage. The lineup also features CHANMINA, globally acclaimed rock band sakanaction, shoegaze-influenced duo Hitsujibungaku, and veteran live favourites Tokyo Ska Paradise Orchestra, who will be joined by special guests AiNA THE END, TAKUMA of 10-FEET, and LiSA.

With more performers set to be announced before the Grand Ceremony on 13 June, keep your eyes peeled for information on the official MAJ website.
